summary.intent: Identify the 'callisto-hardening' session the user had just stopped and determine what follow-up work comes next in the callisto repo.
summary.outcome: The session was not found by name in Entire. After the user ran auth themselves, search worked and the likely match was identified as session 15c732d1 ('review next-work plan', audit-fixes worktree). The time-sensitive next step (moving macos-14 to macos-15 in CI and release workflows) was identified but no edits were started, pending user confirmation.

repo: `.claude/plans/NEXT-WORK.md` was stale (rewritten 2026-10-23); the repo had moved on through PRs #379-#402 including `callisto release pending`, the ecosystem file split and the jsonc-parser refactor.
`registry_endpoint.rs` rejects non-https URLs including loopback, so T12 Cargo/PyPI registry tests cannot target a local registry.
`matrix.rs` carries its own list of 18 target triples, a small cleanup candidate.

Open plan items: spec drift re-verification (about 14% of criteria false or partly true), #290 guard gaps (history capped at 100, merge-only edits missed), private workspace root `npm/monorepo` listed as a package (leaning towards `[[package]] match = "npm/monorepo"` with `ignore = true`), fixed group sharing one tag or release title (E194, needing a design pass on ADRs 9 and 12).
OIDC trusted publishing for npm and the `ready_by_edge` swap (waiting on the next michi release) are blocked on the user or michi.
Merging #409 builds macOS binaries on `macos-14` runners, which are reportedly retired on 2026-11-02. This date came from a search summary and is unverified.
The latest Release run on `main` failed at 'Create or update the Callisto release PR' with a GitHub-side query error that looks transient and hasn't been re-run.

code.finding: Darwin preflight and build jobs pin `macos-14` and need to move to `macos-15`.
Release darwin preflight and build jobs pin `macos-14`. This is the most urgent one because merging #409 builds macOS binaries here.

workflow: Entire titles sessions from their first prompt, not from the Claude Code session names, so searching by a custom name finds nothing. Searching by session id works.
Local Claude transcripts in `~/.claude/projects/<project>/*.jsonl` carry `aiTitle` and `customTitle` fields and can be used to identify recent sessions when Entire is unreachable.
The sandbox proxy causes TLS certificate errors (x509 OSStatus -26276) for `entire` network calls, so the user must run `! entire ...` commands outside the sandbox.
Entire's index only held checkpoints up to 2026-10-22, so work from the day of the session was not searchable.

friction: Entire search and Brain lookups were blocked by the sandbox TLS proxy, and the auto-mode classifier denied an unsandboxed retry.
Searching for 'callisto-hardening' and 'road-to-alpha-callisto' returned nothing useful, so identifying the session took several rounds of transcript digging.
Several shell one-liners for reading transcript titles failed or returned nothing (stat and ls format flags on macOS) before a Python approach worked.
The session match is still uncertain and rests on inference rather than confirmation from the user.
open_items: Confirm that session 15c732d1 is the intended hardening session.

Move the four `macos-14` lines in callisto-ci.yml and callisto-release.yml to `macos-15` before #409 merges, add a workflow contract test for runner names, and create a trail first. Verify the retirement date against GitHub's changelog.

Choose the exclusion shape for the private workspace root `npm/monorepo`.
Design pass on ADRs 9 and 12 for fixed groups sharing one tag or release title (E194).
Decide an approach for T12 Cargo/PyPI registry tests or drop them.
Clean up the duplicated 18 target triples in `matrix.rs`.

OIDC trusted publishing for npm (priority raised 2026-10-23) and the `ready_by_edge` swap awaiting the next michi release.
